darkmode.settings.title: Dark Mode
darkmode.settings.hint: Changes to colors apply when you close this screen.
darkmode.settings.enabled.tip: Turn dark screens on or off.
darkmode.settings.theme.tip: The tint of dark screens. Winter also lets snow fall behind menus.
darkmode.settings.brightness.tip: How bright dark screens are. Lower is darker.
darkmode.settings.loading.tip: What the Mojang loading screen shows: a color, a Christmas landscape, or your own image.
darkmode.settings.mods.tip: Also darken screens from other mods.
darkmode.settings.hud.tip: Also darken the hotbar and other parts of the HUD.
darkmode.settings.backgrounds.tip: Darken light backgrounds that screens draw in code instead of with a texture.
darkmode.settings.text.tip: Brighten dark text so it stays readable.
darkmode.settings.skipped.tip: Mod ids, separated by commas. Their screens keep their normal colors.
darkmode.settings.image.tip: Drop a PNG onto this screen and it becomes your loading screen. Or put it in config/darkmode as loading.png and pick "Your image".
darkmode.settings.image.done: Image saved. The loading screen now shows it.
darkmode.settings.image.bad: That is not a PNG image Dark Mode can read.
darkmode.settings.image.drop: Or drag a PNG onto this screen to use it as your loading screen.
